payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all pairs of candidate days (with at least n/2 available students) and checks feasibility using a counting argument for student assignment.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively tries all possible day pairs (at most 10), which is a complete search. Among the given subtypes, backtracking is the closest match as it generalizes trial-and-error over a search space; no recursion, bitmask, or graph traversal is used.
